author: Evolve
text_post: Different Nice Guy Problem I'll keep this quick. Everything has been going well for me except for one little snag. As I go out and build my skill through practice, I'll sometimes find myself in a position of rousing success, but then stuck with someone feeling hurt when I keep going out and running sets. Now I know the best solution is to have this not come up because it was a non-issue from us being on the same page from the get go and I am working on (and getting better) at that. However, in the mean time I do end up unhappy when I have to talk down someone who has a different impression about "where we want this to go". Are there any pointers you guys have about how to handle these situations until I can perfect myself to the point where it no longer arises?
